typography.instructions: Use Outfit for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Use Figtree for body text. Ensure tight tracking for headings > 32px.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with PASTEL & SOFT
colors.instructions: Warm and approachable. No generic SaaS blue. Use Terracotta (primary) sparingly for CTAs and important actions. Background is a warm bone-white to reduce eye strain. Text is deep charcoal, never pure black.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism (Tactile)' style for cards: Flat white background, 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E1D8]), soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and slightly larger shadow (shadow-md).
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft rounded corners (rounded-2xl for large cards, rounded-xl for inputs and buttons).
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous touch targets. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 between grid items.
visual_enhancers.effects: No full-screen gradients. Solid warm colors are preferred. Ensure the header has a background (solid or glassmorphism) so it never clashes with content.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or large rounded-xl. Primary buttons must use the primary terracotta color. Add hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs customized: rounded-xl, bg-white, subtle border. Focus ring should be the primary color with ring-offset-background. Must have large enough height (h-12) for mobile touch targets.
components.cards: Course listing cards must have clear visual hierarchy: Course Name (H3), Start Date (badge or small bold text), Description, and a full-width 'Enrol Now' button at the bottom.
components.forms: Use single-column layout for forms since it is mobile-first. OTP input must use standard accessible multi-input with clear numeric keyboard trigger on mobile. Add a 'Resend OTP' button with a visual cooldown timer.
components.tables: Admin dashboard table should be clean, responsive (scrollable horizontally on mobile) with striped rows or simple bottom borders.

layouts.global: Mobile-first approach. Max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
layouts.hero: Stack layout on mobile (Text + CTA -> Image). Image should have rounded corners and not exceed 60vh. Text left-aligned.
layouts.course_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Direct children only.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout on desktop, hamburger menu with off-canvas sidebar on mobile.

motion.hover: Hover states on all buttons and cards. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for course cards using Framer Motion (initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}).
motion.form_feedback: Use Sonner for success/error toasts after form submission or admin actions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons has 4.5:1 contrast. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.forms: All inputs must have associated labels (sr-only if visually hidden, but preferred visible for mobile).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='enrol-button', data-testid='otp-input', data-testid='course-card').

images.description: Group of young adults learning together, friendly and collaborative atmosphere. Fits the 18-28 target demographic.
Teacher instructing a class, showing professionalism and active learning.

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all icons. Ensure stroke-width is 1.5 or 2 for clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind blues or grays. Use the defined warm tones.
Ensure the header has the business name 'Fatima's Spoken English Centre' as text. No logo image.
OTP verification must include a 'Resend' cooldown timer (e.g., 30s) to prevent spam.
Mobile experience is the priority. Forms must be single-column and easy to tap.
Do not add any 'AI slop' gradients. Stick to the solid warm background and terracotta accents.
Ensure the Admin dashboard is protected by login and provides a simple toggle for 'Course Active' status.
Make sure to implement the requested fonts (Outfit and Figtree) in your global css or index.html.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
